task: Making a bottle cap magnet (gluing a magnet to a bottle cap)
query: How do I make a bottle cap magnet by gluing a magnet to a bottle cap?

goal.title: Assemble and test a bottle-cap spinner
goal.description: Use hot glue to attach small round metal pieces at the center of a plastic cap, press the pieces into place, and test rotating the cap between the fingers. The metal pieces are also removed and repositioned.
goal.final_state: The plastic cap is held up while a dark round metal piece remains separately on the table; a permanently secured finished spinner is not established.
procedure: Inspect the plastic cap and round metal pieces.
Pick up and prepare the hot-glue gun, then apply glue at the cap center.
Press a small piece into the center and test-fit a larger round piece.
Apply more glue and press a metal piece onto the other face.
Flick and turn the cap between the fingers, adjust or remove the metal pieces, and inspect the cap.

phases.description: The cap and metal pieces are inspected, hot glue is applied to both faces, metal pieces are pressed into position, and the cap is flicked and rotated. Pieces are repeatedly detached and refitted; the cap is displayed at the end.
